subject: Judge: quote-aware redirect fix in orch-gate-bash.sh
description:
Single-attempt code review (self-learn-judge in single-attempt review mode) of the impl attempt for the quote-aware redirect-detection fix in hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh.

Invoke self-learn-judge against the impl's attempt branch orch/attempt/<impl-key>. Fetch the attempt diff (get_attempt_diff) and apply the code-review rubric: correctness, scope discipline (must be ~2-3 lines, redirect-detection only — NO changes to tee/cp/sed/python checks or to the TARGETS extraction loop), dead/redundant code, test/verification presence, style match.

SECURITY-CRITICAL acceptance checks — the diff MUST preserve detection of real writes. Verify the masking uses a placeholder token (not deletion) so:
  (a) `find . -name '*[<>:\"|?*]*'`  → does NOT set WRITE_PATTERN (false-positive fixed)
  (b) `echo x > \"file\"`            → STILL sets WRITE_PATTERN (no new bypass)
  (c) `cmd > out.txt`                → STILL sets WRITE_PATTERN
  (d) tee / cp / mv / sed -i / python open(...,'w') detection unchanged
If masking deletes quoted spans rather than replacing with a placeholder, KICK BACK (creates a redirect-to-quoted-filename bypass). APPROVE = hold-merge verdict (flat task, not under a feature); KICK BACK = set_status failed + wired record_decision. NEVER force-merge.
